title: Abby and the Rock That Blinked
synopsis: Abby the octopus is so good at blending into her underwater garden that her friend Deb mistakes her for a rock with an eye.

related_resources.reason: Octopuses can rapidly alter their skin color and texture to blend into surrounding rocks and sand.
